findings.text: the closing count 'families with a committed renderer: 5' folds in reposed-fixture under a verdict the row itself labels 'committed renderer candidate' (qualified: solovev_certificate.py writes into the family's output root and its own SVG basenames, but the report itself flags that other consumer files share overlapping basenames like 'analytic-clipped'), so the top-line 5/9/0 split reads slightly stronger than the row-level evidence it is built from; the caveats section does disclose the qualification for gate-c-resolve and wholecell-rows but not explicitly for reposed-fixture, which is the one rolled into the unqualified '5' bucket rather than a fourth caveat line.

justifications.durability: the report and its four supporting artifacts (search-tracked.json, driver-hashes.json, runs-hit-files.txt, runs-by-family.txt, search_tracked.py) are all present on disk exactly where the manifest says, nothing was committed or needed to be (the deliverable is read-only), and the report is internally self-contained: every verdict states the exact file, line numbers and hit counts a reader can re-check without re-running the search.
justifications.evidence: I independently re-verified a wide, essentially exhaustive sample of this report's specific claims and every one reproduced exactly: the positive-control sha256 (benchmarks/wholecell_rows_reposed_fixture.py hashes to 9f25d58e0c88...25801, matching receipt.json's driver_sha256 verbatim), five separate line-number citations in solovev_certificate.py (90, 2038, 2039, 3218, 4193), the zero-savefig claim in wholecell_rows_reposed_fixture.py, two savefig line numbers in limited_row_shadow_census.py (765, 1114), the vertex_ring_census.py and private_region_figures.py line citations, and the two raw file line-counts (577, 13879) for the runs-directory search outputs. Nothing checked disagreed with the report.
justifications.fit: no plan/stage/sprint label appears anywhere in the report, script, or artifact filenames; the node's own script (search_tracked.py) and JSON schema names describe what they measure rather than which followup or plan item motivated them, and the report explicitly names its own instrument's positive control (the wholecell-rows hash match) before reporting the negative results, which is the correct order for an implausible-absence claim.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the stated goal (locate the renderer for each of 14 figure families, or state none is committed) is answered for all 14 with a specific, checkable verdict and command trail; three instruments were triangulated (tracked-tree grep, crew-runs-directory search, receipt-hash match) rather than relying on one, and the private-region finding (renderer located only via figure basenames because the family path string never appears literally in code) is exactly the kind of non-obvious result a plain directory-name search would have missed and reported as 'not-committed' incorrectly.
justifications.scope_discipline: the node made no commits and touched no path outside its declared reports directory (git status is empty in the worktree and shows only pre-existing peer artifacts in the main checkout), and it explicitly declined to phrase around the one check-manifest finding it cannot avoid (no commit exists for a report-only deliverable) rather than inventing a fabricated commit reference to satisfy the field's shape.
